versions.content: The Det error DEM_E_WRONG_CONFIGURATION shall be re- ported if the function Dem_SetDTCFilter is called with a value of the parameter DTCOrigin that is not supported per configuration (e.g. if DTCOrigin " DEM_DTC_- ORIGIN_MIRROR_MEMORY " is passed, but no mirror memory is configured).
